summary: Backend email notification wiring verified for all 4 workflow triggers (create/approve/reject/return-for-revision). Emails are dispatched non-blockingly via asyncio.to_thread and failures do NOT block workflow (proposals still transition correctly). HOWEVER: Resend API rejects EVERY send with 'The botree.co.in domain is not verified.' — no email is actually delivered.
passed: Login for Sales, CGO, Finance users via cookie auth
POST /api/proposals creates proposal (200) and triggers send_workflow_notification to CGO
POST /api/proposals/{id}/approve as CGO transitions status to finance_review (200) and triggers notification to Finance
POST /api/proposals/{id}/reject as CGO transitions status to rejected (200) and triggers notification to creator
POST /api/proposals/{id}/return-for-revision as CGO transitions status to needs_revision (200) and triggers notification to creator
Email failures do NOT block workflow — all 4 endpoints return 200 and DB status updates persist even when Resend send throws
Async non-blocking pattern confirmed (asyncio.to_thread wrapping resend.Emails.send, log entries in expected order)
Exceptions caught in send_workflow_notification and logged as ERROR (no 500s bubble up)

failed.issue: Every email send returns error: 'The botree.co.in domain is not verified. Please, add and verify your domain on https://resend.com/domains'. No email is actually delivered to any recipient (CGO, Finance, or creator). Zero successful 'Email sent to ... - Email ID: ...' log lines were observed across all 8 send attempts (4 workflow events x 2 test runs).
failed.evidence: Backend log lines from /var/log/supervisor/backend.*.log e.g. '2026-07-28 06:53:38,916 - server - ERROR - Failed to send email notification: The botree.co.in domain is not verified.' repeated for create/approve/reject/return.

action_items: Verify the botree.co.in domain in the Resend dashboard (https://resend.com/domains) — add SPF/DKIM DNS records — OR temporarily set SENDER_EMAIL to Resend's default onboarding@resend.dev for testing. Until domain is verified, NO emails will be delivered even though code path is correct.
After domain verification, re-run the same create→approve→reject→return flow and confirm 'Email sent to ... - Email ID: ...' INFO log lines appear (and recipients actually get the message).
notes: Resend API key is valid and reachable (Resend responds with a specific domain-verification error, not an auth error). This is purely a Resend account/DNS setup issue — code implementation is correct and robust (graceful failure, non-blocking async, all 4 triggers wired).
